tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night is the stage, slides and video ground; Day is the working console ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and cards that sit on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, popovers, code and policy.yaml blocks on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, panel edges, dividers. Decorative only, never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and inputs. At least 3:1 on surface and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the gate post in the mark. Reads on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, units, captions. At least 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Tollgate cyan: the barrier arm, links, focus ring, primary buttons. Day uses the deep cyan so it holds 4.5:1 as text on white.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: allow
tokens.usage: Decision allow: traffic passed the gate. Same hue as the brand on purpose.

tokens.name: allow-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint behind allow text.

tokens.name: redact
tokens.usage: Decision redact: content passed with parts replaced. Text on ground, surface and redact-soft.

tokens.name: redact-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint behind redact text.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Decision block: request or response stopped. Text on ground, surface and block-soft.

tokens.name: block-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint behind block text.

tokens.name: kill
tokens.usage: Decision kill_session: the whole session terminated, usually a canary leak.

tokens.name: kill-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint behind kill text.

tokens.name: canary
tokens.usage: The canary only: the mascot in the mark and canary-trip moments. Never body text; put on-canary text on it.

tokens.name: on-canary
tokens.usage: Text on a canary fill.

families.sans: Overpass, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Stage screen, slide cover, video title. Night theme only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Slide titles and stage section heads.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in the console, subtitles on slides.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every request and every answer goes through the gate.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.sample: Window 5 m. Updates every 2 s from the event stream.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on tiles and stage strips. Uppercase is set in CSS.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Big numbers on tiles and the stage screen. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Rule ids, hashes, keys, policy.yaml excerpts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; tile grid gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding in the dense console.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default panel padding; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; slide inner padding on small frames.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing; stage screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Barrier-stripe pitch; slide margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Stage screen outer margin; slide margins at 1920 px.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, rule-id pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels; the barrier arm.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stage cards and slide frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and toggles only.
